title: 第314章 救不了花姨第313章 走向灭亡的根源
slug: 无敌镖人开局护送灭世帝女
lines: 无常少司只来得及发出一声惊骇的呼喊，便“砰”的一声，被那只巨手当场捏成了一团血雾。
“你妹的，虎口夺食！”
陈观低骂一句，一刀【开道斩】悍然挥出！
巨大的刀影撕裂天穹，朝着那只巨手竖劈而下！
而那只巨手猛然收掌握拳，一拳轰在了刀影之上。
整个天地瞬间失去色彩，一股浩荡的冲击力扩散开来，将整片天空的乌云瞬间吹散。
小镇的废墟，连同周围的几座小山，被这股能量余波硬生生夷为平地，烟尘蔽日！
直至一切尘埃落定，那只大手也连同那道裂缝一起，消失得无影无踪。
陈观抬头看了看恢复如初的天空，撇了撇嘴。
“这是砍死了，还是砍跑了？”
他琢磨了一下，多半是后者。
因为他能感觉到，那家伙的实力强横，不在自己之下，单凭撕开虚空裂缝这一手，就绝非凡辈。
“难不成是个地仙？”
陈观又摇了摇头。
他没在那只巨手上感受到任何仙灵之气，只有一股阴沉暴虐的诡异之气。
如果没猜错，那只手的主人，应该就是渡厄司那位司王了。
这个司王，很可能是一个天人境后期强者。
“哎，本以为能找个对手，就这么跑了。”陈观收刀入鞘，失望地摇了摇头。
护盾之中，颜宝儿与燕乐乐二女瞪大眼睛，仍愣愣地盯着天空。
刚才那毁天灭地的一幕，不仅打破了她们对修行的认知，也彻底颠覆了她们对强者的想象。
传说中的仙人，也不过如此吧？
陈观走上前，一指点在那透明的屏障上，将其解除，随后笑道。
“怎么样，这一刀帅吧？”
“嗯！”小丫头水果食，使劲点头，“大哥哥好帅！”
颜宝儿也呆呆地说：“确实……帅。”
“帅什么帅？”陈观脸色一板，指着眼前空无一物的平地，“这一切都是你造成的，老子帮你摆平了，难道你不应该说声谢谢？”
“呃！”颜宝儿回过神看向陈观，“你都这么厉害了，一声谢谢……至于吗？”
“我去！”陈观一听，瞬间就不乐意了，“这死丫头想耍赖？”
颜宝儿见他的脸色黑了起来，赶紧连连摆手：“谢谢谢谢，非常感谢！”
【叮！宿主恪尽职守，在这场危急的伏击中，以一己之力力挽狂澜，帅呆全场，不仅惊退敌人，还获得了镖主发自内心的五星好评！】
【评价：雇主全家一致五星好评！】
【任务镖点奖励增加：10%！】
【当前任务奖励：镖点+896】
看到这镖点到账，陈观才满意地点了点头，再看向这丫头，顺眼多了。
颜宝儿看了看陈观，有些搞不懂这个家伙，一句谢谢能把他乐成这样？
但紧接着，她脸上又流露出一副极致悲伤之色。
她缓缓转过身，迈开脚步朝着之前那个高台的位置而去，来到这片空地上，她看着眼前空无一物的滚烫地面，怔怔地发着呆。

Wuchang Shaosi only had time to let out a horrified cry before he was crushed into a ball of blood mist by the giant hand with a "bang".
"Your sister is trying to steal food from the tiger's mouth!"
Chen Guan cursed in a low voice and swung out his sword [Clearance Slash]!
The huge knife shadow tore through the sky and struck down vertically towards the giant hand!
And the giant hand suddenly closed its fist and punched the knife shadow.
boom! ! !
The entire world lost color instantly, and a mighty impact spread, blowing away the dark clouds in the entire sky instantly.
The ruins of the town, together with several surrounding hills, were flattened by the aftermath of this energy, and the sun was covered in smoke!
Until all the dust settled, the big hand disappeared without a trace along with the crack.
Chen Guan looked up at the restored sky and curled his lips.
"Did he be hacked to death, or was he hacked away?"
He thought about it, and it was probably the latter.
Because he could feel that the strength of that guy was tyrannical and not inferior to his own. His ability to tear open cracks in the void alone was extraordinary.
"Could it be that he is an earthly immortal?"
Chen Guan shook his head again.
He didn't feel any fairy aura in that giant hand, only a gloomy, cruel and strange aura.
If you guessed correctly, the owner of that hand should be the Si Wang of Duesi.
This King Si is probably a powerful person in the late stage of Heavenly Realm.
"Hey, I thought I could find an opponent, so I just ran away." Chen Guan sheathed his sword and shook his head in disappointment.
Within the shield, Yan Baoer and Yan Lele stared blankly at the sky with their eyes wide open.
The devastating scene just now not only broke their understanding of practice, but also completely subverted their imagination of strong men.
The legendary immortal is nothing more than that, right?
Chen Guan stepped forward, pointed at the transparent barrier, lifted it, and then smiled.
"How about it? Isn't this sword handsome?"
"Yeah!" The little girl nodded vigorously, "Big brother is so handsome!"
Yan Baoer also said blankly: "Indeed...handsome."
"Why are you so handsome?" Chen Guan's expression was stern and he pointed at the empty land in front of him. "You are the cause of all this. I helped you settle it. Shouldn't you say thank you?"
"Uh!" Yan Bao'er came back to his senses and looked at Chen Guan, "You are so awesome, how about a thank you...?"
"I'll go!" When Chen Guan heard this, he immediately became unhappy, "Is this damn girl trying to cheat?"
Seeing that his face turned dark, Yan Baoer quickly waved her hands: "Thank you, thank you, thank you very much!"
[Ding! The host performed his duties conscientiously. In this critical ambush, he single-handedly turned the tide and stunned the audience. Not only did he frighten away the enemy, but he also received a heartfelt five-star praise from the escort master! 】
[Evaluation: The employer and the whole family unanimously praised it with five stars! 】
[Quest dart point reward increase: 10%! 】
[Current mission reward: Dart points +896]
Seeing that the escort was paid, Chen Guan nodded with satisfaction and looked at the girl again, which was much more pleasing to his eyes.
Yan Baoer looked at Chen Guan, a little confused about this guy. How could a thank you make him happy like this?
But then, a look of extreme sadness appeared on her face.
She slowly turned around and walked towards the previous high platform. When she came to this open space, she looked at the empty hot ground in front of her, and she was in a daze.
